svg.aria-label: Kahn's Algorithm (BFS-Based Topological Sort) Execution Sequence

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Kahn's Algorithm (BFS-Based Topological Sort) Execution Sequence

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) & In-degrees

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step-by-Step Kahn BFS In-degree Execution Sequence

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: A
in: 0

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: B
in: 0

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: C
in: 2

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: D
in: 1

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: E
in: 1

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: F
in: 2

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Queue Invariant:
- Q holds all vertices with in-degree = 0 (ready)
- Dequeue u: append u to topological order
- For each (u -> v): decrement in-degree(v)
- If in-degree(v) == 0: enqueue v into Q

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Cycle Detection Property:
- DAG: all |V| vertices enter Q and are output
- Cycle: cycle nodes never reach in-degree 0
- If length(order) < |V|: cycle detected!

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Init: in={A:0, B:0, C:2, D:1, E:1, F:2} | Q = [A, B] | Order = [ ]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step 1: Pop A -> Order = [A] | Decr in(C): 2 -> 1 | Q = [B]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step 2: Pop B -> Order = [A, B] | Decr in(C): 1 -> 0 -> Enqueue C | Q = [C]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step 3: Pop C -> Order = [A, B, C] | Decr in(D): 1->0, in(E): 1->0 -> Enqueue D, E | Q = [D, E]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step 4: Pop D -> Order = [A, B, C, D] | Decr in(F): 2 -> 1 | Q = [E]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step 5: Pop E -> Order = [A, B, C, D, E] | Decr in(F): 1 -> 0 -> Enqueue F | Q = [F]

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Step 6: Pop F -> Order = [A, B, C, D, E, F] | F has no out-edges | Q = [ ] (Empty)

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Final Topological Order: A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F
6 of 6 vertices processed (|Order| = |V|) ==> Valid DAG Topological Sort confirmed

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Kahn Algorithm Complexity: Time = Theta(V + E), Auxiliary Space = Theta(V)
Optimal linear-time queue processing identical to BFS traversal

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Kahn's BFS-based algorithm repeatedly removes in-degree 0 sources, decrements neighbor in-degrees, and appends to topological order
